subject: Coord: CloudWave SI x Redwood marketplace co-sell — availability matrix request

Cc: partner-ops@cloudwave.io
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace co-sell demo — propose windows (AWS SI presence?)

Hi Jordan / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro last week. CloudWave is excited to get a joint marketplace demo scheduled for our AWS co-sell listing. We want to include a short SI technical segment (20 minutes) to cover architecture and integration pointers for AWS Market.

Proposed constraints:
- Preferred week: Dec 6–10 (US PST-friendly)
- Audience: 15–20 engineers + 3 product folks
- Must-have: one AWS SI engineer and one Redwood Solutions engineer on the call

Can you share a concise availability matrix (blocks of 60 or 90 minutes) in PST and CET? If you prefer, Vanessa, feel free to send over a few calendar picks and we’ll confirm.

I attached a draft agenda and a short ops checklist.

Thanks,
Michael

Michael — thank you, this is helpful. Looping in Kimberly from Solutions so we can lock an ops runbook and confirm which Redwood model variants we’ll demo. Also cc’ing Vanessa to coordinate the marketplace logistics and AWS SI ask.

Quick plan:
- Kimberly: can you propose 3 windows (PST) during Dec 6–10 where you and an engineer can join for a 90-min run-through + 20-min SI deep-dive?
- Vanessa: we’ll need the AWS SI contact and ideal start time for the marketplace listing owner to join. CloudWave’s ask for CET conversion is noted — I’ll include that in the matrix.

I’ve attached the agenda Michael sent and added a two-line Operating Notes section for Redwood. If there are constraints (e.g., blackout on Dec 8 morning), call them out.

Jordan Blake

[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

All — thanks for the context. I pulled team availability and built the matrix below (all times in PST / converted to CET in parentheses). Each slot is a 90-minute demo + 20-minute optional SI deep-dive at the end. Please pick one preferred + one alternate.

Option A: Dec 6, 10:00–11:30 PST (Dec 6, 19:00–20:30 CET) — Redwood SE + infra lead available
Option B: Dec 7, 13:00–14:30 PST (Dec 7, 22:00–23:30 CET) — Redwood SE only (infra lead unavailable until 11/30)
Option C: Dec 9, 08:30–10:00 PST (Dec 9, 17:30–19:00 CET) — best for APAC-attending customers; infra lead can join first 45 minutes

Notes / constraints:
- We prefer Option A or C to ensure the infra lead is present for the SI section.
- If CloudWave needs an earlier CET-friendly slot, we can do Dec 6 at 07:00 PST (16:00 CET) but that reduces attendance from Redwood product.
- Attach: ops-runbook-notes.pdf (includes default runbook, required ports, SSO checklist, and who to page for escalation).

Action items:
- Michael: confirm which option (A/B/C) and whether you’ll have the AWS SI engineer on the full call or only for the deep-dive (last 20 min).
- Vanessa: can you confirm marketplace owner (name + email) and whether we need to include a vendor intake brief in the invite? If so, we’ll add 10 mins at the top for listing admin.

Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
